sourcePolicy: MGPL Joint AI Agent Operating Plan v3.3 section 19.2

profileSwitching.implementation: Use the canonical Cline VS Code configuration with only the named enabled set for the active work unit.
profileSwitching.isolatedProfiles: Use separate reviewed configuration copies or Cline CLI --config/data-dir only when a role-specific session is required.

implementation.writePolicy: No database, infrastructure, issue-tracker, or observability writes by default.

review.writePolicy: Read-only review. Any review publication requires one explicitly approved action.

infrastructure.writePolicy: Read-only preferred. Mutation requires an approved work unit. Provisioning and credential creation remain Principal Operator responsibilities.

notes: The VS Code Cline extension currently uses one active MCP configuration rather than native role-profile switching.
Profile definitions are repository-owned policy artifacts; enabling a conditional server requires an explicit reviewed configuration change or isolated session configuration.
No credential values are stored in this profile document.
